description: Comprehensive Qatar (قطر / Qatar) official holidays from 1971 through 2030. All vacanza supported_languages: ar_QA, en_US; all supported_categories: bank, public (bank:81 / public:413). Country code QA. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) via holidays.QA(years=range(1971, 2031), language=L, categories=(C,), islamic_show_estimated=True) iteration over L in ('ar_QA', 'en_US') and C in ('bank', 'public'). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=240, is_observed=0). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False.
